output:
**To:** Bethan Rees  
**Subject:** Re: Nia’s hen

Hiya Beth,

Just landed off a Lagos so forgive me if this makes no sense, my head’s mush! I saw your email and wanted to message you separately, not get into it on the group.

I do get why you don’t fancy a whole weekend in the cottage. Things have been awkward since Lowri’s 40th, and I know you were both upset by what was said. I’m not taking sides or asking you to pretend everything’s fine. I do think Lowri’s probably sorry too, even if she’s being stubborn about it. You’re as bad as each other sometimes!

But would you have a think about coming just for Saturday? Skip Friday and the paddleboarding, no problem. You’d only need to be in Tenby for about 6 before the meal at 7.30. Train from Cardiff Central is about two and a half hours, and I’ll pick you up from the station. I’ve got the twin room so you can kip in with me Saturday night.

Nia rang me crying last week asking if you were still coming. She doesn’t know you’ve pulled out yet. I know you’re seeing her at the wedding at Margam on 17th April, and doing the reading, but I’d love you to be there for this too. You sat with her in the Heath every night when her mam was bad in 2019. You’ve always been there for her, and I know having you there would mean a lot.

I swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry from work to get the weekend off and gave up a night stop I really wanted, so I’m determined we’re going to have a good time! I’d hate for you to miss it and regret it, or for Nia to look back and remember you weren’t there.

And hang on before sending Lowri any money. She’s said not to worry about it, and we can work out the practical bits if you decide to come Saturday.

No pressure to answer now. Just have a think, lovely? I’d really like to see you there.

Love,  
Siân xx
